# Calvary Chapel Frederick

> A Calvary Chapel church in downtown Frederick, Maryland. Verse-by-verse Bible teaching. Pastor David Ochoa.

Calvary Chapel Frederick meets at 244A S Jefferson St, Frederick, MD 21701.

Service times (America/New_York):
- Sunday 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM
- Wednesday 7:00 PM Bible study

Children’s ministry:
- Sunday: infants through 5th grade
- Wednesday children’s church: ages 3–11
- Middle school Sunday 9:00 AM; high school attends the main service
- Midweek youth: Ignite (middle and high school)

The church does not pass an offering plate. Giving is via sanctuary boxes or online.

Official site: https://www.calvaryfrederick.com
Phone: +1-301-663-4485
Email: info@calvaryfrederick.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/): Overview, times, ministries, latest teaching
- [Plan a Visit](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/visit/): What to expect, kids, beliefs, visit form
- [Watch](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/watch/): On-demand messages (Subsplash)
- [Give](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/give/): Offering boxes and online giving
